fullContent:
Vidangadi Thailam (Oil) – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali, page no. 814. 
 Vidangadi Thailam (Oil) is used to treat anorexia, urticaria, itching, ulcerative colitis, elephantiasis, fever etc. 
 Ingredients 
 Take 20 gram of each of:- 
 
 Vayavidanga 
 Marich 
 Arkmooltavak 
 Sonth 
 Chitrakmool 
 Devdaaru 
 Alua 
 Sandhav 
 Samudra lavana (Sea salt) 
 Savarchal lavan 
 Vidalvan 
 Abhodhilavan 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Take 20 -20 gram of each ingredient. Make the powder of all ingredients and make the kalk with water. Then prepare the oil with taila pak method. 
 Dosage 
 6 to 12 gram. It is administered with warm milk or water or cow’s urine. 
 Indications 
 
 Anorexia 
 Urticaria 
 Itching 
 Ulcerative colitis 
 Unconsciousness 
 Fever 
 
 Side Effects 
 Take this medicine only under medical supervision. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
